summary: By allowing external data sources to execute these operators natively, the proposal aims to reduce network traffic and improve query performance. The team is actively monitoring the bot, implementing safety mechanisms to halt and revert if issues arise, and refining the trigger via the ai-review-requested label. Participants weigh the benefits of requiring Java 25, noting limited maintenance gains and unclear performance improvements, and ultimately agree to adopt Dongjoon's proposal. This SPIP extends push-down to include missing join types, set operations, and window functions, allowing the source to decline any push and have Spark execute locally if needed.
